description: Will this CSV survive a typed round trip and a spreadsheet: leading zeros, big ids, dates, formulas, empty vs null — Parses CSV text (RFC 4180, caller dialect) against a column type map and reports, per cell with row, column, physical line and byte offset, everything that would change on a parse-serialize-parse round trip or when opened in Excel or Sheets: leading zeros stripped, integers beyond 2^53 or 15 significant digits, scientific-notation and date coercion ("1E5", "1-2", "MARCH1"), formula injection (= +

header.description: First row is a header (default true). Without one, columns are named 0, 1, 2...

nullToken.description: Text that means null (e.g. "NULL", "\\N"). Default: none, so only an unquoted empty field is null.

types.description: Object mapping column name to one of string, identifier, integer, decimal, boolean, date, datetime (max 200). Unlisted columns are "string". Use "identifier" for digit strings that must keep leading zeros.

name: csv-roundtrip
